title: Bound on a multiplication row
statement: Let $t$ be a bit, let $b$ be a finite bit string, and let $j,k$ be nonnegative integers. The row sum obtained by summing the product of $t$ and each bit of $b$ at position $q$ for which $k+q=j$, with all other terms zero, is at most $1$.
